test_compare_profiles: test the compare_profiles module by parsing NVTX events from an in-memory sqlite database and verifying timing summaries
get_sqlite_events: create a function that parses NVTX_EVENTS from an sqlite database connection and returns a list of Event objects
create_summary_from_events: build a timing summary from a list of NVTX profiling events grouped by event name with inclusive and exclusive times
print_summaries: print a formatted table of profiling summaries to stdout with optional relative timing comparison across multiple profiles
create_arg_parser: create an argparse parser with options for sorting by inclusive or exclusive time and configuring source time units per second
